profile.headline: Software Engineer @ ACLU | M.S. in Data Science | Advocate for Diversity in Tech
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Data-driven, people-first Software Engineer based in New York City. Currently supporting the Educate Pod at ACLU using PHP and Vue.js to build innovative digital experiences for their websites, and pursuing a Data Science master's degree at CUNY School of Professional Studies.

Graduated from CUNY New York City College of Technology in 2022, holding a bachelor's degree in Emerging Media Technology and Game Design. I enjoy volunteering in the tech community, learning new skills, and watching musicals in my free time.

As for my previous experience, I've had internships in front-end, back-end, quality assurance automation, and data analysis. I've collaborated with internal stakeholders to introduce business solutions involving automation, accessibility, developer experience, and data collection. This work ranges from start-up to multinational operations, such as NBCUniversal, Disney, Electronic Arts, and Twitter. Transparency, frequent communication, and leading with empathy are the values I follow in and out of the workplace.

My main interests are in developer experience, internal tooling, gameplay programming, and automation. However, I still identify as a generalist and enjoy a variety of technical roles across the tech stack. Feel free to connect to learn more about my experience and background!

(Techquitable Futures, Girls Who Code, and CUNY Tech Prep alum. Current Gameheads student.)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Rebuilding legacy hard-coded page templates as reusable, mobile-first atomic components using PHP, Vue.js, and Tailwind CSS
• Engineering content and WordPress CMS enhancements in partnership with the CMS team to improve SEO and AEO performance, increasing the discoverability of web content across traditional and AI-powered search
• Developing and shipping weekly features for ACLU.org and 50+ affiliate sites, serving 1M+ monthly visitors, while fixing critical production bugs and implementing WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards 
• Translating requirements from 10+ product, content, security, and design stakeholders into technical implementations, coordinating feature delivery across multiple projects, such as the National Brand Refresh and Know Your Rights redesigns
positions.insights: Skills: Bulma (CSS Framework) · SQL · Git · SASS · Vue.js · PHP · JavaScript · GitHub · WordPress · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improved on-call experience and real-time observability monitoring by optimizing dashboards in Python
• Presented an API service for a feature engineering testing tool in Scala for Machine Learning engineers
• Decreased manual effort in the Twitter for iOS and Android mobile release process by expanding automation infrastructure to calculate, store, and notify engineers of daily release insights using Python, SQL, Jira REST API, and Jenkins
• Created onboarding documentation to successfully ramp-up incoming engineers to internal QE development projects and systems
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · SQL · Relational Databases · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Bazel · Scala · Jenkins

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Led the shell script to Bazel (Starlark) migration within the framework and infrastructure testing team
• Resulted in an over 30% reduction of shell scripts needed to perform system and unit tests with Starlark integration in the Jenkins CI/CD pipeline
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Bazel

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Improved the workflow of updating the Madden NFL franchise SQL database by building an automated data entry script using C#
• Implemented a new C# feature for the asset management tool to instantly reflect data changes in the game that reduced latency for future Madden NFL design and development processes

positions.title: QA Automation Intern
positions.description:
• Researched open-source technologies and tools to create an accessibility-focused testing framework from scratch with JavaScript, Node.js, Mocha, and Selenium WebDriver
• Led the implementation of the Axe accessibility testing API to ensure Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) compliance for web and mobile applications
• Integrated Bash scripts for web applications into the Jenkins CI/CD pipeline, automating 34% of accessibility test cases
positions.insights: Skills: Test Automation · Git · Accessibility Testing · JavaScript

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: • Solidified the knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Computer Science fundamentals through hosting weekly individual and group tutoring sessions for 17 students

company.name: Research Foundation of The City University of New York

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description: • Building a data collection of popular kinky, curly hair products with user reviews through web scraping from online retailers with Python (BeautifulSoup)
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analysis · Git · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Media Tech Intern
positions.description:
• Authored the documentation to guide new and 20+ existing internal business users through a content planning tool for Peacock's TV series and features
• Reported application bugs found in the content planning tool and created JIRA tickets for TV Delivery's agile development + QA team (Operations & Technology department)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Designing, prototyping, and launching responsive websites from scratch with Canva, inVision, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap, and JavaScript (jQuery), including the Institute of the first Black congresswoman, Shirley Chisholm
• Increasing website traffic, speed, accessibility, and search engine ranking through implementing SEO improvements

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Spearheaded a research and development project with documentation and data visualization on the usage of TRS' various platforms that discovered interaction patterns and user demographics based on 27M+ records using Tableau
• Categorized and analyzed 200K+ error messages in Tableau pulled from SQL queries to ease the legacy to modernization database migration process

company.name: Teachers'​ Retirement System of the City of New York

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
• Created 5 new SQL queries to analyze trends spanning across 10 years of data within the Traffic Report database system records
• Extracted and stored Weekend Traffic Advisory report data in CSV using Python's BeautifulSoup library
• Automated GEOJSON file to CSV conversion using Python (Pandas) by pair-programming a script in Jupyter Notebook
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Data Analysis · Python (Programming Language) · Jupyter

positions.description: • Selected for a virtual internship to introduce students regardless of their major to cybersecurity, as an academic discipline and a career alternative. Through group and individual projects, students are able to develop and enhance their soft skills using cybersecurity as the use case.

projects.title: The Lament
projects.description:
The Lament is a point-and-click visual novel that follows the selkie Nisaea, as she searches to uncover the cause of her people’s declining population, and the disappearances of neighboring pods when her pelt is stolen, marooning her on land.

Role: Programmer

projects.title: Enjoy Your Stay in Paradise
projects.description:
In the dialogue-driven game, “Enjoy Your Stay In Paradise,” experience the disconnect between the expectations of tourists and the reality of the locals in modern Maui through a food truck simulator.

Role: Programmer, Project Manager
